Which of the following random variables follows a geometric distribution?

I. The number of cards randomly selected from a deck before selecting a club, if we replace the card after each draw

II. The number of times we randomly select a club from a deck if we pick $10$ cards from a standard deck.

III. The number of polled people who answered who they voted for in an election until one person says they voted for candidate A
